form.oneLiner: Reconcile payments to records by embedding metadata into every transaction
form.realStory: Businesses lack the data richness to understand cash flow without manual reconciliation across disconnected systems. We embed structured metadata into every transaction so records and payments stay in sync automatically.
form.customers: Australian SMBs running Xero, Stripe, Square, and Tyro — finance ops teams burning hours per week on manual matching
form.proof: Live integrations with Xero + Stripe. Pilot merchants reducing reconciliation time by 80%+.

brandWorld.brandPersonality: Precision-engineered payments reconciliation — dark, data-dense, technically credible, with a teal pulse that signals accuracy over aesthetics.
brandWorld.visualDirection: Command-operational fintech tooling — dark navy field, single teal accent, ledger-precise typography in Barlow Condensed for displays + DM Sans for body + JetBrains Mono for numbers. Glow, grid, and grain overlay communicate that the chrome itself is part of the engineering credibility.
avoid: Warm consumer palette (the brand is not friendly, it is precise)
brandWorld.whyThisWorks: SyncPay's product is precision reconciliation — every transaction either matches or doesn't. The chrome mirrors that: hairline grid, teal pulse, no ambiguity. Investors immediately read 'engineered for finance ops' before they read a single word.
motifs: Ledger ruled lines as structural dividers
Payment rail arrows — left-to-right directional match lines
Reconciliation diff columns — debit beside credit, hairline gap
Statement-style row stripes with mono digit columns
Teal pulse on match — single accent moment, no ambient noise
brandWorld.backgroundSystem: Dark navy field, subtle 64px grid mask, two soft radial teal washes top-corners, fractal noise grain overlay at 25% opacity
brandWorld.deckTheme: A dark command-operational fintech deck — Barlow Condensed displays in teal/snow, statement-style metric cards, ledger-rules between sections, glow on the load-bearing accent
